findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 載明 Coinbase 須遵守美國商務部 BIS 等管轄的出口管制法規與 OFAC 制裁規定；屬合規義務，未見關稅或實體清單對其產品或供應鏈的具體衝擊描述。
findings.excerpt: We are also required to comply with export control laws and regulations administered by the United States and other applicable jurisdictions, including those administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因子指出，隨國際擴張，公司可能面臨涉及制裁、出口管制與反洗錢的調查或執法。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: we may be subject to inquiries, investigations, and enforcement actions by U.S. and non-U.S. regulators and governmental authorities, including those related to sanctions, export control, and anti-money laundering.

note: 搜尋 1 次未找到 2026 年 Coinbase 直接受關稅或出口管制影響的來源。2025 年 4 月 Oppenheimer 筆記將關稅不確定性連到零售交易量，日期不在 2026，未採用。
